Included in the $249/month package

Automated review requests.
Make feedback easier.

Ask for customer feedback as part of finishing the job. We plan clear review invitations and reminders for US local businesses, with an agreed review destination and the same opportunity for every customer to share an honest experience.

Talk about your business

Ask at a sensible moment.

The request should follow an agreed point in your customer journey, such as a completed job. We plan the invitation and where the review link should lead, so the customer knows what they are being asked to do.

Keep the invitation clear.

A short thank-you, an invitation to share their experience, and a direct review link are easier to understand than a long marketing message. The wording should sound like your business and welcome honest feedback.

Use reminders thoughtfully.

We agree on timing and stopping rules for reminders. Every customer should have the same opportunity to leave an honest review; the flow does not screen people by satisfaction or promise a particular rating.

Choose a real completion point.

Tell us how your business knows a job or visit is finished and which review destination you want customers to use. We plan who is eligible, when the invitation is sent, and how reminders stop. Use a verified review link and neutral wording so customers can share their own experience without a suggested rating or pressure to write particular comments.

What’s included

  • A straightforward review invitation
  • Follow-up reminders for eligible customers
  • The same opportunity to leave honest feedback for everyone
For example

After a completed job, a customer receives a thank-you message with a review link. If needed, a reminder follows using the schedule agreed with you.

Your questions,
answered.

When should a business ask a customer for a review?

Choose a point when the customer has experienced the service, such as a completed job or visit. We agree on the trigger and timing with you so the invitation makes sense. A short thank-you and a direct review link keep the request easy to understand.

Can review requests link to my Google Business Profile?

A request can use your verified Google review link when that is the agreed destination. You supply the correct business profile and confirm ownership. The website package does not imply that ongoing Google Business Profile posting or management is included.

Do you filter unhappy customers or promise positive reviews?

No. Review invitations welcome honest feedback and do not screen customers by satisfaction. We do not write reviews for customers, invent ratings, or promise a score. Reminders use an agreed schedule and stopping rules.
